question: Drag the learning rate until gradient descent converges to the origin within 30 steps on this anisotropic loss surface. Too small and it inches; too large and it oscillates along the narrow axis.
explanation: On f(x, y) = x² + 5y², the optimal learning rate is bounded by 1/(largest curvature) = 1/(2 · 5) = 0.1. Anything ≥ 0.1 oscillates along y; anything ≪ 0.1 crawls along x. The sweet spot is roughly 0.07-0.09.
